summary: It manages the visibility state of a greeting component.
It uses a useEffect hook to change the displayed message after a delay when visible.
It renders a launch button until the content is visible, and a close button when visible.
purpose: The main purpose of this file is to display an animated 'Hello World' greeting that is initially hidden behind a launch button.
risks: The animation timing (500ms) is hardcoded and not configurable.
The component relies on external styling via inline styles, which is not scalable.
No error handling is present if state updates fail or if the component lifecycle is interrupted unexpectedly.
